scope: Diagnostic camera and visible composition only

camera.background: distant painted panorama; near and middle geometry share real perspective and depth

geometry.relation: a continuous low rock shelf and exposed bedding; remote structures never grant support

scenery.relation: near bearing shoulder continues under the walkable terrace; a lower shoulder is glimpsed through the open cliff window
scenery.animation: slow atmospheric density drift only; no simulated living-body movement

actorProjection.depth: per-pixel physical pose; real shared depth buffer

state.visibility: open visual workbench; tactical perception is not enabled or validated
state.simulation: shared production Player/input and physical-grid sweep only; no RiftScene, combat, search, inventory or save
